title: Security First
description: Every design decision considers the threat model. Never implement custom crypto. Always use well-vetted libraries.

title: Clean Architecture
description: Code should be modular, testable, and maintainable. SOLID principles guide every architectural decision.

title: Incremental Growth
description: Never generate entire projects at once. Build incrementally, test continuously, refactor fearlessly.

title: Learn by Building
description: The best way to learn is to build real projects. Every project teaches something new about software engineering.
